Package com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.cql

Class StatementBuilder<SelfT extends StatementBuilder<SelfT,​StatementT>,​StatementT extends Statement<StatementT>>

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.cql.StatementBuilder<SelfT,​StatementT>
  • Direct Known Subclasses:
    BatchStatementBuilder, BoundStatementBuilder, SimpleStatementBuilder
    @NotThreadSafe
public abstract class StatementBuilder<SelfT extends StatementBuilder<SelfT,​StatementT>,​StatementT extends Statement<StatementT>>
extends Object
    Handle options common to all statement builders.
    See Also:
    SimpleStatement.builder(String), BatchStatement.builder(BatchType), PreparedStatement.boundStatementBuilder(Object...)
